name: Jayanta Mohapatra/ଜୟନ୍ତ ମହାପାତ୍ର

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Jayanta Mahapatra (1928–2023) was a poet from Cuttack whose literary life grew alongside a career teaching physics. Writing in English and Odia, he also edited the literary journal Chandrabhaga. His collections include A Rain of Rites, published by the University of Georgia Press in 1976; he received the Sahitya Akademi Award in 1981.

In “Playing the Magician,” a newspaper report, a passing train and an animal’s death disturb the surface of an ordinary day. The poem moves between intimate perception and questions about the country’s conscience. Its shifting images resist an easy resolution: the observing mind remains entangled in the world it tries to understand.
